title: Bakelite - The Birth of Modern Plastics

sentences.en: In 1907, Leo Hendrick Baekeland, a Belgian scientist working in New York, discovered and patented a revolutionary new synthetic material.
sentences.zh: 1907年,在纽约工作的比利时科学家Leo Hendrick Baekeland发现一种革命性的新合成材料,并获得专利。

grammar.type: 主干结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: His invention, which he named ‘Bakelite’, was of enormous technological importance, and effectively launched the modern plastics industry.
sentences.zh: 他发明了“Bakelite”这个名字, 具有巨大的科技重要性, 并有效地启动了现代塑料工业。

grammar.type: 定语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The term ‘plastic’ comes from the Greek plassein, meaning ‘to mould’.
sentences.zh: `塑料 ' 一词来自希腊的冰山,意思是“铸造”。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some plastics are derived from natural sources, some are semi-synthetic (the result of chemical action on a natural substance), and some are entirely synthetic, that is, chemically engineered from the constituents of coal or oil.
sentences.zh: 一些塑料来自自然来源,有些是半合成的(对自然物质化学作用的结果),有些完全合成的,即化学工程,由煤或石油成分制造。

grammar.type: 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Some are ‘thermoplastic’, which means that, like candlewax, they melt when heated and can then be reshaped.
sentences.zh: 也表示像蜡烛一样, 热量会融化, 然后可以重新改造。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Others are ‘thermosetting’: like eggs, they cannot revert to their original viscous state, and their shape is thus fixed for ever, Bakelite had the distinction of being the first totally synthetic thermosetting plastic.
sentences.zh: 也有些人是“热调”:像蛋一样, 他们无法回到原来粘稠状态,

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The history of today’s plastics begins with the discovery of a series of semi-synthetic thermoplastic materials in the mid-nineteenth century.
sentences.zh: 当今塑料史始于十九世纪中叶发现一系列半合成热塑性材料。

grammar.type: 主干结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The impetus behind the development of these early plastics was generated by a number of factors – immense technological progress in the domain of chemistry, coupled with wider cultural changes, and the pragmatic need to find acceptable substitutes for dwindling supplies of ‘luxury’ materials such as tortoiseshell and ivory.
sentences.zh: 早期塑料开发背后的动力是由若干因素产生的 — — 化学领域的巨大技术进步,加上更广泛的文化变革,以及寻找可接受的替代 " 奢侈 " 材料供应量(如乌龟壳和象牙)的实用需要。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Baekeland’s interest in plastics began in 1885 when, as a young chemistry student in Belgium, he embarked on research into phenolic resins, the group of sticky substances produced when phenol (carbolic acid) combines with an aldehyde (a volatile fluid similar to alcohol).
sentences.zh: 白兰对塑料的兴趣始于1885年, 当时他作为比利时年轻的化学学生, 开始研究苯丙基树脂, 苯丙醇(碳酸)与甲醛(一种类似于酒精的挥发性液体)结合时生产的粘性物质。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He soon abandoned the subject, however, only returning to it some years later.
sentences.zh: 然而,他不久就放弃了这个主题,但几年后才回到这个主题。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By 1905 he was a wealthy New Yorker, having recently made his fortune with the invention of a new photographic paper.
sentences.zh: 1905年,他是一个富有的纽约客, 最近他发了财,发明了一张新的摄影论文。

grammar.type: 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: While Baekeland had been busily amassing dollars, some advances had been made in the development of plastics.
sentences.zh: 虽然Bekeland公司在忙碌地积聚美元,但在塑料开发方面取得了一些进展。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The years 1899 and 1900 had seen the patenting of the first semi-synthetic thermosetting material that could be manufactured on an industrial scale.
sentences.zh: 1899年和1900年,第一批半合成热调制材料被授予专利,这些材料可以工业规模制造。

grammar.type: 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In purely scientific terms, Baekeland’s major contribution to the field is not so much the actual discovery of the material to which he gave his name, but rather the method by which a reaction between phenol and formaldehyde could be controlled, thus making possible its preparation on a commercial basis.
sentences.zh: 从纯科学的角度来看,Baekeland对该领域的主要贡献与其说是实际发现他所命名的材料,不如说是控制苯酚和甲醛反应的方法,从而有可能在商业基础上进行准备。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: On 13 July 1907, Baekeland took out his famous patent describing this preparation, the essential features of which are still in use today.
sentences.zh: 1907年7月13日,Baekeland公司取出了他著名的专利,描述这一准备,其基本特征今天仍在使用。

grammar.type: 定语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The original patent outlined a three-stage process, in which phenol and formaldehyde (from wood or coal) were initially combined under vacuum inside a large egg-shaped kettle.
sentences.zh: 原专利概述了一个三阶段过程,其中苯酚和甲醛(来自木材或煤)最初在真空中混合,在大蛋形水壶中。

grammar.type: 定语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The result was a resin known as Novalak, which became soluble and malleable when heated.
sentences.zh: 结果形成一种树脂,称为诺瓦拉克树脂,当加热时,可溶性可溶,可耐受。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The resin was allowed to cool in shallow trays until it hardened, and then broken up and ground into powder.
sentences.zh: 树脂被允许在浅盘中冷却,直到变硬,然后碎裂,化成粉末。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Other substances were then introduced: including fillers, such as woodflour, asbestos or cotton, which increase strength and.
sentences.zh: 随后引入了其他物质:包括填充物,如木质、石棉或棉花,这些物质增加了强度和强度。

grammar.type: 定语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: moisture resistance, catalysts (substances to speed up the reaction between two chemicals without joining to either) and hexa, a compound of ammonia and formaldehyde which supplied the additional formaldehyde necessary to form a thermosetting resin.
sentences.zh: 抗湿性、催化剂(加速两种化学品之间反应而无需结合的物质)和六溴,一种氨和甲醛化合物,它提供了形成热调节树脂所需的额外甲醛。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This resin was then left to cool and harden, and ground up a second time.
sentences.zh: 然后,这树脂被留下来冷却和硬化, 并再次被挖出来。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The resulting granular powder was raw Bakelite, ready to be made into a vast range of manufactured objects.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的颗粒粉末是原碱石,可以制成各种制造的物品。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the last stage, the heated Bakelite was poured into a hollow mould of the required shape and subjected to extreme heat and pressure; thereby ‘setting’ its form for life.
sentences.zh: 最后,加热的巴克利石被倒入一个所需的形状的空心铸造,承受着极高的热量和压力,从而 " 定下 " 生命的形式。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The design of Bakelite objects, everything from earrings to television sets, was governed to a large extent by the technical requirements of the moulding process.
sentences.zh: 巴克利特物体的设计,从耳环到电视机,在很大程度上都受铸造工艺的技术要求制约。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The object could not be designed so that it was locked into the mould and therefore difficult to extract.
sentences.zh: 对象无法设计成被锁定在模具中,因此难以提取。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A common general rule was that objects should taper towards the deepest part of the mould, and if necessary the product was moulded in separate pieces.
sentences.zh: 一项共同的一般规则是,物体应冲向铸模的最深部分,必要时,产品应分别成形。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Moulds had to be carefully designed so that the molten Bakelite would flow evenly and completely into the mould.
sentences.zh: 须仔细设计模具,使熔化的巴克利岩能够均衡和完全流入铸模。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sharp corners proved impractical and were thus avoided, giving rise to the smooth, ‘streamlined’ style popular in the 1930s.
sentences.zh: 夏普角被证明不切实际,因此避免了,从而产生了1930年代流行的顺畅、 " 流线 " 风格。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The thickness of the walls of the mould was also crucial: thick walls took longer to cool and harden, a factor which had to be considered by the designer in order to make the most efficient use of machines.
sentences.zh: 铸模的壁厚也至关重要:厚墙需要更长的时间冷却和硬化,设计者必须考虑这一因素,以便最有效地利用机器。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Baekeland’s invention, although treated with disdain in its early years, went on to enjoy an unparalleled popularity which lasted throughout the first half of the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 贝克兰的发明尽管在最初几年受到蔑视,但后来却受到前所未有的欢迎,在整个二十世纪上半叶都受到欢迎。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It became the wonder product of the new world of industrial expansion -‘the material of a thousand uses’.
sentences.zh: 成为工业扩张新世界的神奇产物, “一千种用途的材料”。

grammar.type: 主干结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Being both non-porous and heat-resistant, Bakelite kitchen goods were promoted as being germ-free and sterilisable.
sentences.zh: 巴克利特厨房的商品既无腐蚀又抗热,因此被推广为无菌和可消毒的厨房商品。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Electrical manufacturers seized on its insulating: properties, and consumers everywhere relished its dazzling array of shades, delighted that they were now, at last, no longer restricted to the wood tones and drab browns of the pre-plastic era.
sentences.zh: 电力制造商在绝缘状态下捕捉到: 地产, 世界各地的消费者都喜欢着他们令人惊叹的窗帘, 很高兴他们终于不再局限于塑料前时代的木质调子和棕色棕色的棕色。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It then fell from favour again during the 1950s, and was despised and destroyed in vast quantities.
sentences.zh: 1950年代,它又被抛弃,被弃绝,被大量毁灭。

grammar.type: 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Recently, however, it has been experiencing something of a renaissance, with renewed demand for original Bakelite objects in the collectors’ marketplace, and museums, societies and dedicated individuals once again appreciating the style and originality of this innovative material.
sentences.zh: 然而,最近,它经历了复兴的事物,收藏家市场和博物馆、社会和敬业的个人对原生的巴克利石物体的需求再次增加,再次赞赏这种创新材料的风格和独创性。
